annotations.title: Find a city by the start of its name

description: Find cities and towns worldwide from the first letters of their name (any of 16 languages, accents ignored), with country, region, coordinates, population and time zone. Use for "which Springfield", or to get a place ID. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

admin1.description: Only this region (needs exactly one country): its code from /admin1 ("CA", "02") or its name ("California", "Bayern").

country.description: Only these countries: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, comma-separated (up to 10).

lang.description: Show names in this language (place, region and country): ar, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt, ru, tr, uk or zh ("en-US" works too). Without it, places carry GeoNames' own name (usually the local or international one). Searching always matches every language.

minPopulation.description: Only places with at least this many people (default 0).

q.description: The start of a place name (1-100 characters).

name: find_city
title: Find a city by the start of its name
